reason: Same object and same cause as wordmark-drops-when-you-change-product — one defect, reported twice, and the two disagree with each other on the remedy (that one keeps the 40px left 'because it is the stage's real left edge', this one moves it to 28px), which is itself evidence that no single violated rule exists. The baselines reproduce exactly (36.00 tasks / 36.13 notes / 58.00 timeline, relative to a sheet at 100,18) but the '0.13px agreement, a real contract, not a coincidence' holds at two of six driven widths: 0.13 at 1920 and 1440, 0.87 at 1280 and 1100, 10.95 at 768, and 5.87 at 390 where Timeline is already 8px ABOVE Tasks — two independently chosen head tokens (a 60px centred bar, a 10px pad on a 62px min-height) landing near each other twice, not a rule. The leading claim is also wrong in kind: Timeline's ladder bands those steps by SIZE ('1.5 · all prose, 13 to 20px', '1.2 · 24, 30, 38px', '1.06 · 48px and up'), so a 17px mark on --lead-body is the ladder obeyed, while the proposed hard 22px is 1.294 — the undeclared seventh step the file's own comment says audit.mjs fails. Moving the head to 28px would take the mark off div.tl-stage and section.b-field, the only two boxes that share its left edge, and the finding's own phone re-check (19px var(--gap-line)) lands Timeline at ~35px against Tasks' 42 and Notes' 36.13, leaving the three-way disagreement it set out to close.
